_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A project is one game (a disc image or a homebrew program), and optionally what is already saved on the machine's memory card. No firmware is listed, because a GameCube starts without any dump. The startup program is emulated, and the free sound-processor ROMs are included in this package.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The game. It can be a disc image (.iso or .gcm, or Dolphin's .rvz), a homebrew program (.dol or .elf) that is started directly, or a Wii channel (.wad, as used for WiiWare and Virtual Console games). A .wad makes this a Wii project. It is installed into the console's internal memory before the machine starts and launched from there, as the Wii Menu would do.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: The saved data the machine starts with. Put back exactly what Emulator > Export Save Data... wrote, to continue a run from where another one stopped. The file is never changed, and the project and the movie record exactly which file it was. For a GameCube it is the memory card image under the same name (MemoryCardA.USA.raw, or .EUR. or .JAP. according to the game's region). Leave it empty and the machine starts with an empty, formatted card. For a Wii it is the .zip that Export Save Data writes, holding the game's own save files from the console's internal memory (nand/title/.../data/...). They are put into the game's save folder before it starts. A save from a different game is refused.
